_comment: Orc grunt (content pass C6, plan-content-zones12.md §B): the Warlord's reinforcement wave add — encounter-spawned at the wave-mouth anchor on the 66%/33% HP thresholds, never a zone spawn. Normal tier at the orc band (cL20): individually clearable under boss pressure, a rank below the elite Orc wall. Small XP trickle (contrast the Orc's starved 15 — waves may be farmed only as fast as the boss bleeds). Large aggro sensor so a spawned wave finds the fight on its own while charging in. Speed under the 0.7 PO ceiling. All values [PLACEHOLDER]
